name: River Development Agent Production Execution Authority Implement Command Integration
objective: Integrate the existing DEV-324 production execution authority operational-entry boundary into the real implementRiverDevPlan apply-mode production mutation seam while preserving the existing DEV-314 non-mutating dry-run path. Apply may reach the implementation runner only through an already-produced DEV-323 production execution authority orchestration result admitted by DEV-324 and DEV-314. Dry-run remains admissible without production execution authority. Execution intent must never manufacture authorization or broaden approved scope.
requirements: Integrate DEV-324 specifically into the apply-mode implementRiverDevPlan production mutation seam.
Preserve the existing DEV-314 dry-run admission path because dry-run is non-mutating and existing production callers do not supply DEV-323 production-authority evidence.
Consume an already-produced RiverDevProductionExecutionAuthorityOrchestrationIntegration result for apply-mode production authority.
Do not require a DEV-323 result for dry-run.
Do not construct DEV-321 production authority input inside implementRiverDevPlan.
Do not construct DEV-322 production execution authority composition inside implementRiverDevPlan.
Do not independently invoke or recreate DEV-323 authorization orchestration inside implementRiverDevPlan.
For apply mode, pass the existing DEV-323 orchestration result through DEV-324 for operational-entry admission.
For apply mode, DEV-324 and DEV-314 remain the authoritative operational-entry admission chain.
For dry-run mode, DEV-314 remains the authoritative non-mutating operational-entry admission boundary.
Requested apply is execution intent only and never authorization.
Apply without an existing valid DEV-323 production execution authority result must fail closed before runner execution.
Blocked, incompatible, unauthorized, or unusable DEV-323 authority must fail closed before runner execution.
Dry-run remains source-compatible with existing three-argument callers.
Existing apply callers that do not yet supply DEV-323 authority must fail closed.
Do not create, upgrade, synthesize, or broaden execution authorization.
Do not broaden approved execution scope.
Do not bypass DEV-324 for apply.
Do not bypass DEV-314.
Do not modify the implementation runner.
Do not grant commit, push, deployment, network, secret-access, or unrelated shell authority.
outOfScope: Changing DEV-324 implementation unless a separately proven defect requires correction.
completionCriteria: implementRiverDevPlan accepts optional preexisting DEV-323 production execution authority evidence without requiring it for dry-run.
Dry-run continues through the existing DEV-314 non-mutating admission path.
Apply no longer uses the old direct narrowed-authorization DEV-314 path.
Apply routes preexisting DEV-323 production authority through DEV-324, which delegates final admission to DEV-314.
Apply without a valid preexisting DEV-323 result cannot reach runner.execute.
Apply with a valid preexisting DEV-323 result reaches runner.execute only after DEV-324 and DEV-314 admission.
Existing three-argument dry-run callers remain source-compatible.
Existing three-argument apply callers fail closed until upstream authority propagation is implemented.
Authorization identity is preserved through DEV-324.
No new authorization semantics are introduced.
Exact working-scope and diff-integrity gates pass.
nextStep: Implement the narrow DEV-325 dual-path command boundary: preserve direct DEV-314 admission only for dry-run; require an optional preexisting DEV-323 orchestration result for apply and route apply exclusively through DEV-324. Add focused implement-command tests proving dry-run compatibility and fail-closed apply behavior. Do not modify package execution.
